messages:
Mina: Quick postmortem follow-up from today's KV shard flapping incident — putting remediation -> test additions on this thread. TL;DR: transient KV evictions caused cache misses + costy regen under burst traffic. We need concrete owners and timelines for: regression prompt sets, a focused load test, and a chaos drill that exercises shard eviction fallback.

Josh: Agree. Can we separate immediate regression (promptset) vs medium-term load/chaos? Immediate = add 3 prompt cases that triggered cache regen. Medium = synthetic spike + eviction sim.

Carla: I'll take the promptset curation. I'll pull real traces and distill 6 seeds (cold-start, long-context, many short requests). ETA: end of sprint (Thu).

Sam: I'll own the load test harness. Plan: replicate ramp from 100rps to 2krps across 10 minutes and toggle small TTLs to mimic evictions. Need baseline from infra — @Josh can you post the trace window?

Josh: Linking traces and ops notes here: https://redwood.internal/trace/EVT-2026-kv-evict. Ops snapshot attached in the ticket TICKET-4821.

Mina: Nice. Acceptance criteria for promptset: catches >1 regression in CI (we define regression = >10% tail latency increase OR >2x token generation cost). Put prompts in evals repo under evals/kv-evict/ and wire to nightly.

Carla: noted. I'll open PR with prompt metadata and expected outputs. Will add a small harness to run locally.

Sam: For the load test, can we script TTL toggles? I can add a stage to k6 script to flip TTLs via admin API. Example command:
```
# flip TTL for shard group 7
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \
  https://ops-api.internal/shards/7/ttl -d '{"ttl_seconds":30}'
```
Will add as optional scenario in the load job.

Carla: Also adding prompt variants that exercise streaming and non-streaming paths — the incident showed both behaved poorly.

ops-bot: Created ticket TICKET-4900: "Promptset + load test for KV eviction" assigned to Carla and Sam. Due date 2026-05-14.

QA-bot: Nightly eval job configured: evals/kv-evict runs at 03:00 UTC, notifies #eng-platform on failure.

Josh: We should schedule a chaos drill for next sprint to validate fallback (model routing to warm caches or fallback model). Who wants to lead?

Mina: Josh/Carla/Sam — can we pair on the drill? I propose a tabletop next Tue, and the live drill Wed of next sprint.

Carla: I'm in for the tabletop. I'll draft the scenario doc and checklist (prechecks, rollback, observability asserts).

Sam: Will prepare the test harness and a playbook to induce eviction safely.

Josh: I'll handle monitoring asserts and create alerts that are actionable (e.g., sustained cache miss rate > 5% for 2m -> auto-escalate).

Mina: Great. Owners and timeline summary: Carla = promptset PR by Thu (TICKET-4901), Sam = load test script + TTL toggles by next Tue (TICKET-4902), Josh = monitoring/alert updates + traces by Mon (TICKET-4903). Tabletop Tue, live drill Wed (next sprint).

Carla: Adding acceptance tests: promptset must fail CI on any model change that increases cold-start token cost by >20% vs baseline.

Sam: Load test pass criteria: 95th p99 latency < X ms under synthetic spike AND no more than 2x token cost. Will codify X after baseline.

Mina: I'll own the post-drill writeup and will update the postmortem with links to PRs + lessons.

Josh: Quick ask: can product/solutions sign off on rollout impacts? @Carla please ping them once PR is up.

Carla: Will do.

Mina: Thanks everyone — bump if anything slips. I'll close the loop here once TICKET-4900 moves to In Progress.
